versions.content: OFNS CRC secu red message format: Byte 0: Type = 0x4C Byte 1: CRC Byte 2: D = Time Domain 16 to 31 (Bit 7 to Bit 4) SC = Sequence Counter (Bit 3 to Bit 0) Byte 3: reserved (Bit 7 to Bit 1 ), default: 0 SGW (Bit 0 ) SyncToGTM = 0 SyncToSubDomain = 1 Byte 4 - 7: Ofs TimeNSec = 32 Bit offset time value in nanoseconds
